title: Recurrent Events
author: Isaac Banner
problems: Row 2 "pass through to an ocean wave & balance - larks by left in the center, neighbors by right on the sides" can't start from where the dancers are: The larks cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
Row 7 "neighbors start a half hey - rights on ends, lefts in center" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle of a hey must start on opposite sides of the set.
